description: Fix P2M4_Repeat desc-key reference — CIG bug: contract points at P2M1_Repeat's desc loc-key instead of its own (observed in 4.7). Without this patch, P2M4_Repeat players see P2M1's Energy-Anomaly flavor text and our enhancement injects ASD2A blueprints; with this patch, P2M4_Repeat resolves to its own Power-Usage desc and picks up the correct ASD2D pool.
